title: Harden and tidy the merged-branch cleanup script
description: Follow-up from TASK-1.24 reviews: security MINOR (remote delete without lease), code MINORs (helper name shadowing, untested missing-ref path) and a NIT (fail() does not fail).

nodes.title: Harden and tidy the merged-branch cleanup script
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Protect main and keep CI action pins current

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a remote doit/* branch moves after the script lists it, When --apply runs, Then the remote delete uses --force-with-lease=<ref>:<listed sha>, is refused for that branch, and the script exits 1 naming it
Given a repository with no main or no origin/main, When the script runs, Then a test proves it exits 1 with 'missing ref' and deletes nothing
Given tools/git/prune-merged-branches.js, When it is read, Then the lines() helper is named outputLines and fail() is named reportError, with all tests still passing
